newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Advetech buys firm, cautions holders.
newsitem.headline: Advetech buys firm, cautions holders.

text.p: Advetech Technical Systems Ltd said on Friday its unit Advtech Education (Pty) Ltd had bought Propmear CC which trades as National Computer College for a maximum of 8.73 million rand with effect from January 1, 1997.
The purchase price determined by a 3.5 times multiple of the net profit after tax of National Computer College over the 12 month period December 31, 1997 to December 31, 1998.
Advtech said it was in talks with regards to more acquisitions and urged shareholders to exercise caution in tehir share dealings pending a further announcement.
